source_match.method: Read module mapping and sum sampled instruction addresses inside PE runtime-function table bounds. Compare the loops to disassembly of just node.cpp at the exact dxil-spirv submodule commit. The named functions each produce a 40-byte parent walk with distinct next-pointer offset, null and self-parent termination, and equality result. No debug symbols in the installed PE.
reproduce: Compile node.cpp from the pinned submodule with g++ -O2 -DNDEBUG -std=c++17, include the source root, util/, debug/ and the pinned SPIRV-Headers include/spirv/unified1 directory. Inspect objdump -dC node.o.

scope: Short hardware counter samples during an outstanding compute PSO call. Percentages weight each sample by period. Identifies the sampled inner routines; does not establish an infinite loop, whole-frame cost or a specific caller.
dxil_spirv_config: The pinned converter exposes wmma_rdna3_workaround, wmma_conv_hack and debug_simulate_min16float_min_spec. None selects a faster dominator implementation.
